rules: Keep page-local numbered [1] citations and list references in first-citation order; reuse the same number for repeated sources.
Article: Author surname and initials. Article title. NLM journal abbreviation. Year;volume(issue):pages/article number. doi:linked DOI.
List all verified authors; complete truncated or missing metadata only after checking the original source. Preserve titles and scientific information.
Web: Organization/author. Page title [Internet]. Publication/update date when available [cited date]. Available from: linked URL.
Dataset: Creator. Dataset title [dataset]. Repository; year. Accession and linked persistent identifier.
Use Duna Serif 16.64px, normal weight, line-height 1.7, a fixed number column/hanging indent, and natural wrapping; italicize scientific names only.
Make DOI/URL the link rather than the entire paragraph. Do not add journal-title italics, bold years, or [J]/[EB/OL] labels to this NLM layout.
